rule.statement: A lis pendens registered under Section 66(1) of the Partition Law does not prevent a voluntary alienation of an undivided share or interest in the land until the final determination of the action.
rule.supporting_quote: After a partition action is duly registered as a lis pendens under the Registration of Documents Ordinance no voluntary alienation, lease or hypothecation of any undivided share or interest of or in the land to which the action relates shall be made or effected until the final determination of the action by dismissal thereof, or by the enter of a decree of partition under section 36 or by the entry of a certificate of sale.
